an10.84:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.84:1.3: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.84:2.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti
an10.84:2.3: tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanuggāhati samanubhāsati
an10.84:2.4: so tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno iraṇaṃ āpajjati vicinaṃ āpajjati anayaṃ āpajjati byasanaṃ āpajjati anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati
an10.84:3.1: tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti
an10.84:3.2: kiṃ nu kho ayamāyasmā aññaṃ byākaroti
an10.84:3.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti
an10.84:4.1: tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti
an10.84:5.3: kodhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:6.3: upanāhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ

an10.84:8.3: paḷāsapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:9.3: issāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:10.3: maccherapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:11.3: sāṭheyyapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:12.3: māyāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:13.3: icchāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:14.1: muṭṭhassati kho pana ayamāyasmā uttarikaraṇīye oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpanno
an10.84:14.2: antarāvosānagamanaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ
an10.84:15.1: so vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme appahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an10.84:15.2: so vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme pahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
